content:
- Overestimate prices after strong sentiment spikes (especially +0.5+ sentiment) — model tends to overshoot and then correct.
- Underestimate when sentiment is weak or negative (sentiment < 0.3) — model is overly conservative.
- Lagging mean reversion: model often holds prices too high for 2–3 days after a spike, then drops — adjust downward by 1–2% per day post-spike.
- Forecast horizon 30d: model overreacts to recent sentiment shifts — reduce forecast sensitivity to last 3–5 days of sentiment.
- When sentiment is rising steadily, model tends to over-predict peak — cap forecast at 1.5–2% above recent 7-day high.
- If sentiment is volatile or mixed, model averages too much — use sentiment-weighted moving average (e.g., 3-day sentiment-weighted mean) to adjust forecast.
